cloud.notes: Once Wi-Fi and Local API are enabled, current v1 readings need no cloud session or Energy+ subscription. Initial setup uses the official app; cloud history and firmware updates are separate. This spec does not disable cloud. A deliberate cloud disable also disconnects the official app and stops future firmware updates; pairing mode/factory reset restores it.

device.name: HomeWizard Wi-Fi Energy Socket
device.notes:
SCOPE: HWE-SKT and HWE-SKT-21 on the official **v1** API only, using plain HTTP/80 and `_hwenergy._tcp.local.`. The pinned official compatibility table marks Socket v2 planned/in development. Do not browse `_homewizard` for this spec, do not infer v2 from newer apps/firmware, and do not construct an energysocket certificate identity as evidence of support. HWE-SKT-21 is a measurement-hardware variant; the API product_type remains HWE-SKT.
This first implementation is deliberately **GET-only**. `/api/v1/state` reports actual relay state, switch lock and LED brightness; it does not grant permission to write them. `/api/v1/system` reports cloud_enabled; disabling cloud with PUT also disconnects the official app and stops future firmware updates and is not a routine privacy toggle. No Socket write is declared.
All measurement points are optional when unavailable. Energy totals are kWh, not Wh. `active_power_l1_w` and tariff-1 totals duplicate their aggregate counterparts for backwards compatibility; never add them into the aggregate again. Socket voltage/current are `active_voltage_v` and `active_current_a`, not P1's per-phase `_l1_` spellings.
SAFETY: the socket can switch a mains-powered load even though this spec does not implement switching. Vendor ratings are 3680 W / 16 A maximum and 2760 W / 12 A continuous, with overload/overheat protection. Those limits and protections do not make unattended automation inherently safe and do not replace appliance-specific limits or safety interlocks.

pairing.notes: The enabled v1 API is open on the trusted LAN. The official compatibility table does not support Socket v2, so the P1 physical-button token flow and CA hostname rules must not be copied here.

factory_reset.description: Do not invent a button hold or use pairing mode as a factory-reset substitute. Pairing mode also restores cloud. Consult current vendor support before clearing the unit; this GET-only spec does not disable cloud or alter relay/lock state.
factory_reset.effect: Vendor documentation says factory reset restores cloud communication. The exact physical reset procedure and which Wi-Fi settings or local state survive were not established here.

steps.action: Connect the socket within its rated load and follow HomeWizard Energy's Wi-Fi setup on the same LAN as the client.
steps.expect: The socket advertises _hwenergy._tcp.local.; redact its serial in retained notes.

steps.action: In the official app open Settings → Meters → this Energy Socket and enable Local API.
steps.expect: The advertisement reports api_enabled=1 and path=/api/v1.

steps.action: Require product_type=HWE-SKT, then GET /api over HTTP/80 and confirm api_version=v1.
steps.expect: HWE-SKT identity; firmware_version is not used to infer v2.

steps.action: Read /api/v1/data, /api/v1/state and /api/v1/system with GET only, at intervals no shorter than the documented 500 ms guidance.
steps.expect: Latest measurement, actual relay/lock/brightness state and cloud flag; no PUT or _homewizard probe.

setup.notes: Initial Wi-Fi setup and the Local API toggle use the official HomeWizard Energy app. Whether an account is strictly required was not established; do not claim account-free onboarding. Once enabled, v1 reads need no account, token or physical-button pairing.

rejoin.notes: Use the official Energy app's Wi-Fi/pairing flow for a new network; pairing mode restores cloud. No factory-reset-only rejoin requirement is documented. Rediscover by serial and re-enable Local API only if the new setup state reports api_enabled=0.

steps.action: Run the official Energy app's Wi-Fi/pairing flow for the new network.
steps.expect: The socket returns to the LAN and cloud is re-enabled by pairing mode.

steps.action: Match the v1 advertisement by serial and confirm product_type=HWE-SKT, api_version=v1 and api_enabled=1 before resuming GET reads.
steps.expect: The same v1 socket; do not try _homewizard or v2 paths.

testing.notes: No socket, mains load, token, account or live request was used. Facts are reported from HomeWizard's official API documentation revision 571384adec2183c16a79392a227d0e5ee92b4ee9 and official Python client revision 60be21a42da6700f3939bdbf3ed4e3d87a0bc2d8 with sanitized offline fixtures. This is a GET-only first implementation; no relay, lock, brightness, cloud, reboot or firmware operation was attempted.

variants.notes: One matcher for both HWE-SKT and HWE-SKT-21 because the API exposes the same product_type. HWE-SKT-21's active_reactive_power_var, active_apparent_power_va and active_power_factor are optional runtime-discovered measurements, not a second identity. Expose those entities only when the corresponding response field is present.

covers: HWE-SKT and HWE-SKT-21 v1 discovery and GET-only identity/measurement/state/system
kWh import/export, W/V/A/Hz readings and SKT-21 var/VA/power-factor fields
Read-only power_on, switch_lock, 0-255 brightness and cloud_enabled
not_covered: Socket relay, lock or brightness writes
Cloud-enable changes, v2 discovery/API, raw telegram, history or internet remote control
Token administration, identify, reboot and firmware operations
local_access.summary: Official v1 HTTP API provides local Energy Socket identity, latest electrical measurements, actual relay/lock/LED state and cloud flag without ongoing cloud access.

SocketMeasurement.description: Sanitized HWE-SKT-21-shaped v1 measurement. Original HWE-SKT omits the three extra electrical fields.
parse_rules: All fields are optional when unavailable; missing is not zero.
Use total_power_import_kwh/export_kwh and active_power_w as aggregates. The t1 totals and active_power_l1_w are duplicates for compatibility, never additional values to sum.
Use active_voltage_v and active_current_a for Socket, not P1's active_voltage_l1_v and active_current_l1_a.
Only HWE-SKT-21 documents active_reactive_power_var (var), active_apparent_power_va (VA) and active_power_factor (dimensionless).

api.no_path_fallback: Do not request /api/measurement, /api/user or other v2 routes after a v1 error or timeout.
api.no_v2_discovery: Do not advertise or probe _homewizard for Socket. Official v2 is planned/in development, and certificate type energysocket does not establish support.

polling.freshness: Latest measurement only; use monotonic staleness handling and do not interpret repeated counters as a new sample.

excluded: PUT /api/v1/state for relay, switch_lock or brightness
PUT /api/v1/system for cloud_enabled, which also disconnects the app and stops firmware updates
Raw telegram (P1 only), token creation/deletion, identify, reboot, firmware and every v2 route

remaining_unknowns: No physical HWE-SKT or HWE-SKT-21 was read; actual optional-field presence and firmware-specific behavior remain unverified.
How best to identify SKT-21 hardware when all three extra fields are temporarily unavailable is unresolved; do not invent a product_type.
Whether initial app setup strictly requires an account is unresolved.
Exact factory-reset procedure and Wi-Fi/local-state survival across reset or network changes are not established.
Socket v2 availability and schema are outside scope and must not be inferred from planned documentation or newer app releases.
Relay, lock, brightness, cloud and firmware writes were deliberately not investigated or tested and require separate explicit design and user intent.
